Fresh Harbor Seafood with Outstanding Mantis Shrimp
Apr 2026 • Couples
Came here on the recommendation of our local driver when we were looking for a great seafood restaurant, and it did not disappoint. The restaurant sits right on the harbor overlooking the ocean, with an open-air second-floor dining room that offers a relaxing waterfront atmosphere while staying comfortably shaded.

One of the highlights is choosing your seafood directly from the live tanks. They have a wide selection available, priced by weight, and you simply select what you want and how you’d like it prepared.

We ordered a couple kilos of mantis shrimp steamed with garlic and onion, a whole fried fish, and crab fried rice. Everything was exceptionally fresh and cooked perfectly. The mantis shrimp was the standout—sweet, tender, and incredibly flavorful. The fried fish was crisp and well-seasoned, and the crab fried rice was a great accompaniment to the meal.

Service was friendly, efficient, and helpful throughout.

If you’re looking for fresh seafood in a beautiful harbor setting, this is an easy recommendation. We’d gladly come back again.

Expensive, small and tough lobster – hectic atmosphere
Feb 2026 • Family
⭐️⭐️ (2/5)

We were here for the lobster – and unfortunately, that was a disappointment. The price is disproportionate to the quality: for what you pay, you get surprisingly little meat, and in our case, it was tough and rather dry instead of juicy and flavourful.

On top of that, the atmosphere was generally hectic. It seemed as if the team was under constant stress – the service was correspondingly rushed, and it was impossible to really relax and enjoy the meal.

The bottom line: high prices, disappointing lobster and an unpleasantly stressful atmosphere. I would not recommend this restaurant for a special lobster dinner.

Perfect lobester
Jul 2025 • Couples
This place is awsome, we decided to go there after a quick search on google maps. We were not dissappointed at all, the place was half full and all looked local or simply asian people which is always a good sign. Within twenty minutes the whole restaurant was full. We chose one of the Lobster combos on offer after the suggestion of the very helpful and informative manageress who was looking after us. This included a whole lobster, a plate of oysters and scallops all grilled, and also a massive plate of stri fried rice. The lobster was cooked to perfection, honestly the best I have ever had by far. A waiter even cut it up for us in manageable pieces. Greed set in and we ordered a plate of mantis prawns which was in turn perfect and totally delicious. All this for around 75 euros which include a few beers and also a fresh coconut. I call that a giveaway for a perfect seafood dinner. The place does get very very busy very quickly, so go before 7pm, We had a repeat visit two evenings later and had a grouper which was cooked two ways for us. Half was steamed and half was deep fried with tons of garlic and once again, delicious indeed. We highly recommend this place and the other good thing about it, is that there are about 20 or more waiters looking after guests, and I counted 20 people in the kitchen too. We loved it.
